@Gideon, from the #inc-vtg-hartford history:

- **First report:** your message at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** said the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The channel shows times without a time zone, so I'm quoting them as posted.
- **The guard:** your same message says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. That's the only description of the guard in the channel. Nothing else records what the guard did before kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo checked in trailer 8836.

The channel doesn't say anything else about the guard, so for anything more you'd need the guard's own account or the gate logs.
